plugins.description: oh-my-gajae-code — focused Gajae Code suite with 7 skills and 9 commands. Skills: adaptive-response, no-english, extragoal, insane-review, deep-onboarding, multi-harness-research, ouroboros. Commands: /omg, /omg:setup, /omg:gate, /omg:gate-always, /omg:no-english, /omg:insane-review, /omg:deep-onboarding, /omg:multi-harness, /omg:ouroboros-setup. Multi-harness is explicit-only and directly fans the same task to exactly four read-only harnesses; its private user runtime requires Linux, bubblewrap, and existing provider logins, while only XDG state outside the project receives results. Ouroboros setup is explicit-only, externally installed and upstream-owned (minimum 0.51.7; Python >=3.12); OMG neither bundles it nor its MCP or bridge and never installs or updates it automatically.
